metadata.question: Were there more than 8 active fires in the Sakha Republic on August 6, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS active fire data (MCD14DL collection) for August 6, 2020 in Sakha Republic region 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for fire detection data 3. Logic: Count fire detections and check if > 8 Steps: - Define Sakha Republic geometry (using bounding box coordinates) - Load MCD14DL collection (MODIS Active Fires) for the specific date - Filter by confidence level to get reliable fire detections - Count number of fire detections - Validate count and output appropriate answer For Sakha Republic, I'll use approximate bounding box coordinates that cover most of the region. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sakhaRepublic = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([105, 55, 160, 75]); // Approximate bounds of Sakha Republic const targetDate = '2020-08-06'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fires const firesCollection = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(targetDate, ee.Date(targetDate).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(sakhaRepublic) .filter(ee.Filter.gte('confidence', 30)); // Medium to high confidence fires const fireCount = firesCollection.size(); const countInfo = fireCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detections on ${targetDate}: ${countInfo}`); // Check for empty collection if (countInfo === 0) { console.log("No fire detections found."); console.log("B"); return; } // Get sample fire locations for validation const sampleFires = firesCollection.limit(3); const sampleInfo = sampleFires.getInfo(); console.log(`Sample fire locations: ${sampleInfo.features ? sampleInfo.features.length : 0}`); // Final decision if (countInfo > 8) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
